cooldownSeconds.description: Per-user cooldown in seconds, shared by all nettools commands and tools (0 disables)

requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-attempt timeout for each external HTTP request, in milliseconds

maxRetries.description: Retries for transient failures (network errors, timeouts, 429, 5xx) with exponential backoff and jitter

pingMaxNodes.description: Number of check-host.net probe nodes used by ping

pingPollIntervalMs.description: Wait between ping result polls, in milliseconds

pingMaxPolls.description: Maximum number of ping result polls before reporting partial results

priceListLimit.description: Number of registrars shown in a domain price comparison
